// Generated by scripts/build-offline.mjs. Do not edit the generated sw.js.
const VERSION=__VERSION__,BUILD=__BUILD__,FILES=__FILES__,BYTES=__BYTES__;
const BASE=new URL('./',self.location.href),PREFIX='forest3d-offline:'+BASE.pathname+':',CACHE=PREFIX+BUILD;
const urls=FILES.map(file=>new URL(file,BASE).href),allowed=new Set(urls);
let progress=0,downloading=null;
async function report(data){
 for(const client of await self.clients.matchAll({includeUncontrolled:true}))
  if(client.url.startsWith(BASE.href))client.postMessage({type:'offline-progress',version:VERSION,total:FILES.length,bytes:BYTES,...data});
}
async function complete(){
 const cache=await caches.open(CACHE),keys=new Set((await cache.keys()).map(r=>r.url));
 return urls.every(url=>keys.has(url));
}
function download(){
 if(downloading)return downloading;
 downloading=(async()=>{
  const cache=await caches.open(CACHE);let next=0;progress=0;
  const results=await Promise.allSettled(Array.from({length:4},async()=>{
   while(next<urls.length){
    const url=urls[next++];
    if(!await cache.match(url)){
     const controller=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),60000);
     try{
      const request=new URL(url);if(/\.(?:js|css)$/.test(request.pathname))request.searchParams.set('v',VERSION);
      const response=await fetch(request,{cache:'reload',signal:controller.signal});
      if(!response.ok||response.type==='opaque')throw Error('资源下载失败');
      // A host's HTML error page must never count as a downloaded script/model.
      if(!/\/(?:index|play)\.html$/.test(url)&&(response.headers.get('content-type')||'').includes('text/html'))throw Error('资源内容不正确');
      await cache.put(url,response);
     }finally{clearTimeout(timer);}
    }
    progress++;await report({done:progress});
   }
  }));
  if(results.some(r=>r.status==='rejected')||!await complete())throw Error('下载未完成，请联网重试');
  await report({done:FILES.length,downloaded:true});
 })().finally(()=>{downloading=null;});
 return downloading;
}
self.addEventListener('install',event=>event.waitUntil(download().catch(async error=>{
 await report({error:error.message});await caches.delete(CACHE);throw error;
})));
// A new version waits until existing games close, unless the menu explicitly activates it.
self.addEventListener('activate',event=>event.waitUntil(self.clients.claim()));
self.addEventListener('message',event=>{
 const reply=data=>event.ports[0]?.postMessage({version:VERSION,total:FILES.length,bytes:BYTES,...data});
 if(event.data?.type==='STATUS')event.waitUntil(complete().then(ready=>reply({ready,done:progress})).catch(()=>reply({ready:false})));
 if(event.data?.type==='REPAIR')event.waitUntil(download().then(()=>reply({ready:true})).catch(error=>reply({ready:false,error:error.message})));
 if(event.data?.type==='ACTIVATE')event.waitUntil(complete().then(ready=>{if(ready)return self.skipWaiting();}));
 // Cleanup is requested only by a page matching this worker's release. Older open tabs may
 // still need their version's modules, so keep their caches until all such clients close.
 if(event.data?.type==='CLEANUP'&&event.data.version===VERSION)event.waitUntil((async()=>{
  const clients=await self.clients.matchAll({includeUncontrolled:true});
  if(clients.filter(c=>c.url.startsWith(BASE.href)).length>1)return;
  for(const name of await caches.keys())if(name.startsWith(PREFIX)&&name!==CACHE)await caches.delete(name);
 })());
});
self.addEventListener('fetch',event=>{
 const request=event.request,url=new URL(request.url);
 if(request.method!=='GET'||url.origin!==BASE.origin||!url.pathname.startsWith(BASE.pathname))return;
 // Disk export verifies the current manifest; an older cache cannot replace it.
 if(url.searchParams.has('offline-export'))return;
 if(request.mode==='navigate'&&[BASE.pathname,BASE.pathname+'index.html',BASE.pathname+'play.html'].includes(url.pathname)){
  event.respondWith((async()=>{
   // A fresh online entry must not remain pinned to an old installed HTML page.
   // Bound slow-network waiting; an intact installed release remains the fallback.
   const controller=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),3500);
   try{
    const response=await fetch(request,{cache:'no-store',signal:controller.signal});
    if(response.ok&&response.type!=='opaque'&&(response.headers.get('content-type')||'').includes('text/html'))return response;
    throw Error('在线页面暂时不可用');
   }catch(error){
    const cache=await caches.open(CACHE),saved=await cache.match(new URL('index.html',BASE));
    if(saved&&await complete())return saved;
    throw error;
   }finally{clearTimeout(timer);}
  })());return;
 }
 const canonical=new URL(url.pathname,BASE.origin).href;
 if(!allowed.has(canonical)||(/\.(?:js|css)$/.test(url.pathname)&&url.searchParams.has('v')&&url.searchParams.get('v')!==VERSION))return;
 event.respondWith((async()=>{const cache=await caches.open(CACHE);return await cache.match(canonical)||fetch(request);})());
});
